segments.name: Life insurance
segments.description: Sells nonparticipating ordinary life insurance, mainly traditional whole life and term, to lower middle-income to middle-income Americans through direct-to-consumer and agent channels.
segments.evidence: The life insurance segment is our primary segment and is the largest contributor to earnings in each year presented.

segments.name: Health insurance
segments.description: Provides Medicare Supplement and limited-benefit supplemental health coverage designed to supplement health coverage policyholders already own.
segments.evidence: Globe Life offers Medicare Supplement and limited-benefit supplemental health insurance products that include accident, cancer, critical illness, heart, intensive care, and other health products.

segments.name: Investment
segments.description: Invests a predominantly high-quality, investment-grade portfolio, mainly fixed maturities, to meet policyholder obligations and build shareholder value.
segments.evidence: Excess investment income, the measure of profitability of our investment segment, declined 16% during the year ended 2025 to $138 million from $164 million in 2024.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums for individual life and health insurance, with additional revenue from policy charges on policyholder account values and investment income.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues for individual life and health insurance products are primarily derived from premium income and, to a lesser extent, through policy charges to the policyholder account values on annuity products and certain individual life products.
